**Givebutter and Zeffy stand out as the easiest free donor databases for fundraisers, offering intuitive interfaces with donor profiles, segmentation, and integrated fundraising tools without upfront costs.**[1][2][6]

These platforms prioritize simplicity for small nonprofits or beginners:
- **Givebutter**: Provides free donor profiles with engagement timelines, notes, data hygiene to prevent duplicates, and all-in-one fundraising, contact management, and event ticketing. It's ideal for quick setup and real-time tracking.[1][6]
- **Zeffy**: A completely free solution (sustained by optional donor tips) for storing donor data, segmenting supporters, and automating communications tied to campaigns. It centralizes interactions from donation pages for easy filtering and searching.[2]

Other accessible, low-cost options include:
- **Sumac**: Free basic version or $20/month with add-ons; features customizable searches, reporting, and payment processing for straightforward donor tracking.[3]
- **Donor Action**: Simple interface for data entry, searching, emailing, and integrations like PayPal; focuses on ease for basic communication and management.[3]
- **Little Green Light**: Affordable with prospect tools, personalized comms, and online forms; centralizes donor data in one hub.[1]

| Platform | Cost | Key Easy Features | Best For |
|----------|------|-------------------|----------|
| Givebutter | Free | Profiles, timelines, data hygiene, all-in-one tools | Beginners needing quick fundraising integration[1][6] |
| Zeffy | Free | Segmentation, automation, campaign tracking | Nonprofits wanting zero-cost donor organization[2] |
| Sumac | Free basic / $20+ mo | Searches, reports, payments | Customizable basic management[3] |
| Bloomerang | Paid (~$99+/mo) | Dashboard, wealth screening, auto-updates | Growing teams (less "easy" due to cost)[1][2][6] |

For ease, start with free tools like Givebutter or Zeffy if your needs are basic donor tracking and outreach; scale to paid options like Bloomerang for advanced dashboards if volume grows.[1][2][6] Essential features across easy platforms include donor profiles (names, history, notes), segmentation for targeted emails, and dashboards for retention metrics.[1][2][4]
